texts: How a three.ws model is rendered, from a sentence to a lit, rigged character in your browser tab

three.ws renders 3D with a glTF file, Three.js and WebGL on the viewer's own GPU, so the frames are drawn in the browser rather than streamed from a server. The Article follows one rigged character through making, packing, loading, lighting and animating, with the embed code, the free checking tools, our partners and the roadmap.

issues.quote: The Article follows one rigged character through making, packing, loading, lighting and animating, with the embed code, the free checking tools, our partners and the roadmap.
issues.problem: The post names "The Article" and previews its contents but contains no link, so a reader cannot reach the surface being announced and the post violates the standing rule to link the surface once.
issues.fix: Append one verified link to the live viewer (the subject of the cover image) so the post stands alone: https://three.ws/viewer?src=https%3A%2F%2Fthree.ws%2Fcdn%2Fforge%2Fanon%2Fa9694760-e134-4c5c-b334-59129a2d42c9.glb

issues.quote: The Article follows one rigged character...
issues.problem: The second sentence defers to another publication rather than carrying the detail itself, reading as a teaser; the house contract says to lead with the strongest true statement and not withhold the payoff behind a second surface.
issues.fix: Keep the mechanism lead and fold the article's promise into the post itself via the live viewer link, removing the standalone reference to "The Article."

issues.problem: This phrase does not appear word for word in any passing verification result; the article body says "on the visitor's own graphics chip."
issues.fix: Use "in the browser" or "on the visitor's own graphics chip" to match the live page text.

posts: three.ws renders 3D with a glTF file, Three.js and WebGL in the browser, so frames are drawn on the visitor's own graphics chip rather than streamed from a server. The rigged lighthouse keeper loads lit and animated in the live viewer: https://three.ws/viewer?src=https%3A%2F%2Fthree.ws%2Fcdn%2Fforge%2Fanon%2Fa9694760-e134-4c5c-b334-59129a2d42c9.glb
altText: The lighthouse keeper, a rigged three.ws character in a long yellow oilskin coat, navy knitted cap and black rubber boots, standing in the live glTF viewer under studio lighting

editor.summary: The post is accurate in its mechanism lead but ships without a link to the announced surface, making it a teaser rather than a standalone post. Add the verified live-viewer link and drop the deferred reference to "The Article" so it complies with the link-once rule and house voice.
